correctness.rationale: Both models require at least four draws. An independent integer replay (review-coupon-replay.py, no imports from the frozen package) generated each projective line as the span of a point pair, counted covering subfamilies by cardinality via exact union states, and expanded their surjection counts to recover the positive-base line survival coefficients 13, −78, 234, −182, −78, 130 at h=9,6,4,3,2,1 respectively. A separate ordered-draw recurrence on the size s of the union used transitions from s to s+j of weight C(13−s,j)C(s,4−j) in the full model. These checks recovered the two exact gaps at t=4,5 and all four positive entries at 6–9. With the shared single- and paired-miss powers canceled, the largest remaining numerator base is 220 with coefficient 234. The six negative powers have bases smaller than 220; their absolute sum divided by 234·220^t decreases and the replay recovers B_10=70560095920809667968751/86923383681024000000000<41/50. Thus positivity holds for the full infinite range, not only the enumerated times. Read the bundled verification script but did not execute it.
